Review.title: Review
Review.description: A verified diner reflection submitted on the Hyderabadi Mehfil website.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the authenticated diner who submitted the review.

name.description: Display name of the guest reviewer.

subtitle.description: Guest context or location subtitle such as Verified Diner · Ilford.

quote.description: Written dining reflection from the guest.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp recorded when the review was created.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Publicly readable verified guest reviews created by authenticated diners.
